name: Les trois ailes en forme de bateau, rue Henry Farman
note: issy/boatWings.ts: three crescent glass hulls from OSM plans (43 m), pale floor bands, lifted prows; no photo found, shape from the plan

name: Direction Générale de l'Aviation Civile
note: issy/dgac.ts: long bent 7-level slab, pale walls, dark glazed band per floor, plant box; no photo

name: Aquaboulevard
note: issy/aquaboulevard.ts: OSM-claimed (main commercial way, Pathé wing, annexe); low end, dark pool hall with glass pyramids on its roof, tall teal NE block with sign bands, slide towers/tubes on the NW face; positions read off the IGN ortho

name: Aquaboulevard office slab (white fins)
note: issy/aquaOffice.ts: 7-level glass block with white fins round a garden court; owner photo

name: Héliport de Paris – Issy-les-Moulineaux (pads)
note: issy/heliport.ts: standalone apron, five round pads with painted H, hangar and windsocks read off the IGN ortho

name: Cirque Bormann-Moreno (chapiteau)
note: issy/cirqueBormann.ts: striped big top (20 stripes, red/white guess), scalloped hem, mast, five caravans; replaces civic.json's sign-only salle entry (this include is first)

name: Capgemini (Aquarel)
note: issy/capgemini.ts: 9-level glazed office campus on the Seine from the OSM outer ring (courtyard way as dark well); no photo, from knowledge of Aquarel (Arte Charpentier, 2019)

name: La Barge
note: issy/laBarge.ts: moored restaurant barge, dark hull, white two-deck glazed superstructure; no photo, from OSM plan (building=boat)

name: Mirrored-glass wedge opposite Aquaboulevard
note: issy/mirrorPrism.ts: mirror-glass wedge on OSM 'Colas' office way; 45 m tall end falling to 5 m, flagpoles on the street edge; owner photo, which end is tall is a guess

name: Le Large (Île Seguin)
note: issy/leLarge.ts: the cultural district on the upstream point of the Île Seguin with the Hyde hotel; bronze-framed finned glass blocks with roof gardens, a copper hall swelling to the point under a pale glass box; from the owner's aerial rendering, on OSM's only footprint there

name: Le Large, RCR building (Île Seguin)
note: issy/leLarge.ts leLargeMain: RCR Arquitectes' C-plan offices/cinema/cultural centre; finned bronze glass, a taller northern arm, a copper hall swelling on the downstream end, a garden on the court; from the owner's aerial rendering
